gateway: isolated temporary home, approval=reads; a freshly seeded gateway for the stub screenshots, one for the live ones and one for the walkthrough
data: fictional, seeded through the app's HTTP API (capture/scenes.json)

agent_backend.stub: Kiro Crew's offline stub ACP backend (capture/stub_backend.py) for every other scene; no chat reply is shown from it
agent_backend.credit_reading: the browser answers the top bar's credit readout (/api/sessions/usage) with "no reading", so no account balance or email can be shown

note: The isolated gateway served the Agent Worlds page built into the Kiro Crew checkout (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/agent_worlds, website/src/pages/WorldsPage.tsx) at its /worlds route, because a gateway that still ships the built-in cannot install a second app under the same name. This repository is the externally packaged copy of that page, ported onto the App SDK; PORTING.md lists where the two differ, and none of the differences is on screen in these pictures.
data_notes: The sessions were created empty with a title and no message, so every character is idle: no agent turn ran, and no model was asked anything.
The two scheduled jobs are enabled but not due during the capture, so they show as idle sprites.
The seed fixture is the empty one. The untitled session is the one Kiro Crew opens on its first start, so the scene shows four sessions and two jobs.
